scientific_limitations: Deterministic scalar occupied-patch model only, with constant colonization, smooth extinction switching and increasing plateau lengths.

Weak persistence does not establish finite-population stochastic survival; the critical inverse-linear season-boundary rate belongs to one specified calendar.
Originality is based on inspected publications and actual semantic searches, not exhaustive historical priority or independent review.
title: Sharp seasonal-length threshold for weak persistence in a smooth nonautonomous metapopulation
